content: 長部

original: 1. Mahāpadānasuttaṃ
content: 長部14經/阿波陀那大經(大品[第二])(莊春江譯)[DA.1]

original: Pubbenivāsapaṭisaṃyuttakathā
content: 前世住處關聯的談論

original: 1. Evaṃ me sutaṃ– ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme karerikuṭikāyaṃ.
content: [[evaṃ me sutaṃ#被我這麼聽聞]]：[[ekaṃ samayaṃ#有一次]]，[[bhagavā#世尊]]住在舍衛城祇樹林給孤獨園的花林小屋群中。

original: Atha kho sambahulānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ pacchābhattaṃ piṇḍapātapaṭikkantānaṃ karerimaṇḍalamāḷe sannisinnānaṃ sannipatitānaṃ pubbenivāsapaṭisaṃyuttā dhammī kathā udapādi–
content: 那時，當眾多[[bhikkhu#比丘]][[pacchābhattaṃ piṇḍapātapaṭikkanto#餐後已從施食返回]]時，在麝香玫瑰樹圓亭棚共坐聚集，前世住處關聯的法的談論出現：

original: ‘‘ itipi pubbenivāso, itipi pubbenivāso’’ ti.
content: 「像這樣是前世住處，像這樣也是前世住處。」(1)

original: 2. Assosi kho bhagavā dibbāya sotadhātuyā visuddhāya atikkantamānusikāya tesaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ imaṃ kathāsallāpaṃ.
content: 世尊以清淨、超越常人的天耳界聽見那些比丘的這些交談。

original: Atha kho bhagavā uṭṭhāyāsanā yena karerimaṇḍalamāḷo tenupasaṅkami;
content: 那時，世尊從座位起來後去花林圓亭棚。

original: upasaṅkamitvā paññatte āsane nisīdi, nisajja kho bhagavā bhikkhū āmantesi–
content: 抵達後，在設置的座位坐下，坐下後，世尊召喚比丘們：

original: ‘‘ kāyanuttha, bhikkhave, etarahi kathāya sannisinnā;
content: 「比丘們！現在，在這裡為了什麼談論共坐聚集呢？

original: kā ca pana vo antarākathā vippakatā’’ ti?
content: 還有，你們的談論中間被中斷的是什麼？」

original: Evaṃ vutte te bhikkhū bhagavantaṃ etadavocuṃ–
content: 在這麼說時，那些比丘對世尊說這個：

original: ‘‘ idha, bhante, amhākaṃ pacchābhattaṃ piṇḍapātapaṭikkantānaṃ karerimaṇḍalamāḷe sannisinnānaṃ sannipatitānaṃ pubbenivāsapaṭisaṃyuttā dhammī kathā udapādi–
content: 「[[bhante#大德]]！這裡，當我們餐後已從施食返回，在麝香玫瑰樹圓亭棚共坐聚集時，前世住處關聯的法的談論出現：

original: ‘ itipi pubbenivāso itipi pubbenivāso’ ti.
content: 『像這樣是前世住處，像這樣也是前世住處。』

original: Ayaṃ kho no, bhante, antarākathā vippakatā.
content: 大德！這是我們的談論中間被中斷的，

original: Atha bhagavā anuppatto’’ ti.
content: 然後世尊抵達。」(2)

original: 3.‘‘ Iccheyyātha no tumhe, bhikkhave, pubbenivāsapaṭisaṃyuttaṃ dhammiṃ kathaṃ sotun’’ ti?
content: 「比丘們！你們會想要聽聞前世住處關聯的法的談論嗎？」

original: ‘‘ Etassa, bhagavā, kālo;
content: 「世尊！是為了這個的適當時機，

original: etassa, sugata, kālo;
content: [[sugato#善逝]]！是為了這個的適當時機：

original: yaṃ bhagavā pubbenivāsapaṭisaṃyuttaṃ dhammiṃ kathaṃ kareyya, bhagavato sutvā[ bhagavato vacanaṃ sutvā( syā.)] bhikkhū dhāressantī’’ ti.
content: 凡如果世尊作前世住處關聯的法的談論，聽聞世尊的[教說]後，比丘們將會[[dhāreti#憶持]]。」

original: ‘‘ Tena hi, bhikkhave, suṇātha, sādhukaṃ manasi karotha, bhāsissāmī’’ ti.
content: 「比丘們！那樣的話，你們要聽！你們要[[sādhukaṃ manasi karotha#好好作意]]！我將說。」

original: ‘‘ Evaṃ, bhante’’ ti kho te bhikkhū bhagavato paccassosuṃ.
content: 「是的，大德！」那些比丘回答世尊。(3)

original: Bhagavā etadavoca–
content: 世尊說這個：

original: 4.‘‘ Ito so, bhikkhave, ekanavutikappe yaṃ[ ekanavuto kappo( syā. kaṃ. pī.)] vipassī bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho loke udapādi.
content: 「比丘們！在九十一劫前(從現在起那個在九十一劫時)，凡毘婆尸世尊、[[arahaṃ#阿羅漢]]、[[sammāsambuddhaṃ#遍正覺者]]在世間出現(生起)，

original: Ito so, bhikkhave, ekatiṃse kappe[ ekatiṃ sakappo( sī.) ekatiṃ so kappo( syā. kaṃ. pī.)] yaṃ sikhī bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho loke udapādi.
content: 比丘們！在三十一劫前，凡尸棄世尊、阿羅漢、遍正覺者在世間出現，

original: Tasmiññeva kho, bhikkhave, ekatiṃse kappe vessabhū bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho loke udapādi.
content: 比丘們！就在那個三十一劫，毘舍浮世尊、阿羅漢、遍正覺者在世間出現，

original: Imasmiññeva[ imasmiṃ( katthacī)] kho, bhikkhave, bhaddakappe kakusandho bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho loke udapādi.
content: 比丘們！就在這賢劫，拘留孫世尊、阿羅漢、遍正覺者在世間出現，

original: Imasmiññeva kho, bhikkhave, bhaddakappe koṇāgamano bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho loke udapādi.
content: 比丘們！就在這賢劫，拘那含牟尼世尊、阿羅漢、遍正覺者在世間出現，

original: Imasmiññeva kho, bhikkhave, bhaddakappe kassapo bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho loke udapādi.
content: 比丘們！就在這賢劫，迦葉世尊、阿羅漢、遍正覺者在世間出現，

original: Imasmiññeva kho, bhikkhave, bhaddakappe ahaṃ etarahi arahaṃ sammāsambuddho loke uppanno.
content: 比丘們！就在這賢劫，我現在阿羅漢、遍正覺者在世間出現。(4)

original: 5.‘‘ Vipassī, bhikkhave, bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho khattiyo jātiyā ahosi, khattiyakule udapādi.
content: 比丘們！毘婆尸世尊、阿羅漢、遍正覺者是[[khattiya#剎帝利]]血統，出生在剎帝利家，

original: Sikhī, bhikkhave, bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho khattiyo jātiyā ahosi, khattiyakule udapādi.
content: 比丘們！尸棄世尊、阿羅漢、遍正覺者是剎帝利血統，出生在剎帝利家，

original: Vessabhū, bhikkhave, bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho khattiyo jātiyā ahosi, khattiyakule udapādi.
content: 比丘們！毘舍浮世尊、阿羅漢、遍正覺者是剎帝利血統，出生在剎帝利家，

original: Kakusandho, bhikkhave, bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho brāhmaṇo jātiyā ahosi, brāhmaṇakule udapādi.
content: 比丘們！拘留孫世尊、阿羅漢、遍正覺者是[[brāhmaṇaṃ#婆羅門]]血統，出生在婆羅門家，

original: Koṇāgamano, bhikkhave, bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho brāhmaṇo jātiyā ahosi, brāhmaṇakule udapādi.
content: 比丘們！拘那含牟尼世尊、阿羅漢、遍正覺者是婆羅門血統，出生在婆羅門家，

original: Kassapo, bhikkhave, bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho brāhmaṇo jātiyā ahosi, brāhmaṇakule udapādi.
content: 比丘們！迦葉世尊、阿羅漢、遍正覺者是婆羅門血統，出生在婆羅門家，

original: Ahaṃ, bhikkhave, etarahi arahaṃ sammāsambuddho khattiyo jātiyā ahosiṃ, khattiyakule uppanno.
content: 比丘們！我現在阿羅漢、遍正覺者是剎帝利血統，出生在剎帝利家。(5)

original: 6.‘‘ Vipassī , bhikkhave, bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho koṇḍañño gottena ahosi.
content: 比丘們！毘婆尸世尊、阿羅漢、遍正覺者姓憍陳如，

original: Sikhī, bhikkhave, bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho koṇḍañño gottena ahosi.
content: 比丘們！尸棄世尊、阿羅漢、遍正覺者姓憍陳如，

original: Vessabhū, bhikkhave, bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho koṇḍañño gottena ahosi.
content: 比丘們！毘舍浮世尊、阿羅漢、遍正覺者姓憍陳如，

original: Kakusandho, bhikkhave, bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho kassapo gottena ahosi.
content: 比丘們！拘留孫世尊、阿羅漢、遍正覺者姓迦葉，

original: Koṇāgamano, bhikkhave, bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho kassapo gottena ahosi.
content: 比丘們！拘那含牟尼世尊、阿羅漢、遍正覺者姓迦葉，

original: Kassapo, bhikkhave, bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho kassapo gottena ahosi.
content: 比丘們！迦葉世尊、阿羅漢、遍正覺者姓迦葉，

original: Ahaṃ, bhikkhave, etarahi arahaṃ sammāsambuddho gotamo gottena ahosiṃ.
content: 比丘們！我現在阿羅漢、遍正覺者姓[[gotama#喬達摩]]。(6)

original: 7.‘‘ Vipassissa, bhikkhave, bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa asītivassasahassāni āyuppamāṇaṃ ahosi.
content: 比丘們！毘婆尸世尊、阿羅漢、遍正覺者的壽命量是八萬年，

original: Sikhissa, bhikkhave, bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa sattativassasahassāni āyuppamāṇaṃ ahosi.
content: 比丘們！尸棄世尊、阿羅漢、遍正覺者的壽命量是七萬年，

original: Vessabhussa, bhikkhave, bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa saṭṭhivassasahassāni āyuppamāṇaṃ ahosi.
content: 比丘們！毘舍浮世尊、阿羅漢、遍正覺者的壽命量是六萬年，

original: Kakusandhassa, bhikkhave, bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa cattālīsavassasahassāni āyuppamāṇaṃ ahosi.
content: 比丘們！拘留孫世尊、阿羅漢、遍正覺者的壽命量是四萬年，

original: Koṇāgamanassa, bhikkhave, bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa tiṃsavassasahassāni āyuppamāṇaṃ ahosi.
content: 比丘們！拘那含牟尼世尊、阿羅漢、遍正覺者的壽命量是三萬年，

original: Kassapassa, bhikkhave, bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa vīsativassasahassāni āyuppamāṇaṃ ahosi.
content: 比丘們！迦葉世尊、阿羅漢、遍正覺者的壽命量是二萬年，

original: Mayhaṃ, bhikkhave, etarahi appakaṃ āyuppamāṇaṃ parittaṃ lahukaṃ;
content: 比丘們！我現在的壽命量少、微、短：

original: yo ciraṃ jīvati, so vassasataṃ appaṃ vā bhiyyo.
content: 凡長久地活命，他有百年，或少許更多的。(7)

original: 8.‘‘ Vipassī, bhikkhave, bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho pāṭaliyā mūle abhisambuddho.
content: 比丘們！毘婆尸世尊、阿羅漢、遍正覺者{{note|trigger=在波吒釐樹下|text=「波波羅樹下(DA.1)」，南傳作「在波吒釐樹下」(pāṭaliyā mūle)，Maurice Walshe先生英譯為「在喇叭花樹下」(trumpet-flower tree)。}}[[abhisambuddho#現正覺]]，

original: Sikhī, bhikkhave, bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho puṇḍarīkassa mūle abhisambuddho.
content: 比丘們！尸棄世尊、阿羅漢、遍正覺者在分陀利樹下現正覺，

original: Vessabhū, bhikkhave, bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho sālassa mūle abhisambuddho.
content: 比丘們！毘舍浮世尊、阿羅漢、遍正覺者在沙羅樹下現正覺，

original: Kakusandho, bhikkhave, bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho sirīsassa mūle abhisambuddho.
content: 比丘們！拘留孫世尊、阿羅漢、遍正覺者在金合歡樹下現正覺，

original: Koṇāgamano, bhikkhave, bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho udumbarassa mūle abhisambuddho.
content: 比丘們！拘那含牟尼世尊、阿羅漢、遍正覺者在優曇鉢果樹下現正覺，

original: Kassapo, bhikkhave, bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho nigrodhassa mūle abhisambuddho.
content: 比丘們！迦葉世尊、阿羅漢、遍正覺者在尼拘律樹下現正覺，

original: Ahaṃ, bhikkhave, etarahi arahaṃ sammāsambuddho assatthassa mūle abhisambuddho.
content: 比丘們！我現在阿羅漢、遍正覺者在菩提樹下現正覺。(8)

original: 9.‘‘ Vipassissa , bhikkhave, bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa khaṇḍatissaṃ nāma sāvakayugaṃ ahosi aggaṃ bhaddayugaṃ.
content: 比丘們！毘婆尸世尊、阿羅漢、遍正覺者名為騫茶、低舍雙弟子是最上的雙賢，

original: Sikhissa, bhikkhave, bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa abhibhūsambhavaṃ nāma sāvakayugaṃ ahosi aggaṃ bhaddayugaṃ.
content: 比丘們！尸棄世尊、阿羅漢、遍正覺者名為阿毘浮、三巴哇雙弟子是最上的雙賢，

original: Vessabhussa, bhikkhave, bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa soṇuttaraṃ nāma sāvakayugaṃ ahosi aggaṃ bhaddayugaṃ.
content: 比丘們！毘舍浮世尊、阿羅漢、遍正覺者名為受那、鬱多羅雙弟子是最上的雙賢，

original: Kakusandhassa, bhikkhave, bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa vidhurasañjīvaṃ nāma sāvakayugaṃ ahosi aggaṃ bhaddayugaṃ.
content: 比丘們！拘留孫世尊、阿羅漢、遍正覺者名為威度樂(無可比擬者)、慎伎哇(復活者)雙弟子是最上的雙賢，

original: Koṇāgamanassa, bhikkhave, bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa bhiyyosuttaraṃ nāma sāvakayugaṃ ahosi aggaṃ bhaddayugaṃ.
content: 比丘們！拘那含牟尼世尊、阿羅漢、遍正覺者名為畢佑沙、鬱多羅雙弟子是最上的雙賢，

original: Kassapassa, bhikkhave, bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa tissabhāradvājaṃ nāma sāvakayugaṃ ahosi aggaṃ bhaddayugaṃ.
content: 比丘們！迦葉世尊、阿羅漢、遍正覺者名為低舍、婆羅墮若雙弟子是最上的雙賢，

original: Mayhaṃ, bhikkhave, etarahi sāriputtamoggallānaṃ nāma sāvakayugaṃ ahosi aggaṃ bhaddayugaṃ.
content: 比丘們！我現在阿羅漢、遍正覺者名為舍利弗、目揵連雙弟子是最上的雙賢子。(9)

original: 10.‘‘ Vipassissa, bhikkhave, bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa tayo sāvakānaṃ sannipātā ahesuṃ.
content: 比丘們！毘婆尸世尊、阿羅漢、遍正覺者有三次弟子們的聚集：

original: Eko sāvakānaṃ sannipāto ahosi aṭṭhasaṭṭhibhikkhusatasahassaṃ, eko sāvakānaṃ sannipāto ahosi bhikkhusatasahassaṃ, eko sāvakānaṃ sannipāto ahosi asītibhikkhusahassāni.
content: 一次弟子們的聚集有六百八十萬比丘，一次弟子們的聚集有十萬比丘，一次弟子們的聚集有八萬比丘，

original: Vipassissa, bhikkhave, bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa ime tayo sāvakānaṃ sannipātā ahesuṃ sabbesaṃyeva khīṇāsavānaṃ.
content: 比丘們！毘婆尸世尊、阿羅漢、遍正覺者的這三次弟子們的聚集全部都是漏已滅盡者。

original: ‘ ‘ Sikhissa, bhikkhave, bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa tayo sāvakānaṃ sannipātā ahesuṃ.
content: 比丘們！尸棄世尊、阿羅漢、遍正覺者有三次弟子們的聚集：

original: Eko sāvakānaṃ sannipāto ahosi bhikkhusatasahassaṃ, eko sāvakānaṃ sannipāto ahosi asītibhikkhusahassāni, eko sāvakānaṃ sannipāto ahosi sattatibhikkhusahassāni.
content: 一次弟子們的聚集有十萬比丘，一次弟子們的聚集有八萬比丘，一次弟子們的聚集有七萬比丘，

original: Sikhissa, bhikkhave, bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa ime tayo sāvakānaṃ sannipātā ahesuṃ sabbesaṃyeva khīṇāsavānaṃ.
content: 比丘們！尸棄世尊、阿羅漢、遍正覺者的這三次弟子們的聚集全部都是漏已滅盡者。

original: ‘ ‘ Vessabhussa, bhikkhave, bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa tayo sāvakānaṃ sannipātā ahesuṃ.
content: 比丘們！毘舍浮世尊、阿羅漢、遍正覺者有三次弟子們的聚集：

original: Eko sāvakānaṃ sannipāto ahosi asītibhikkhusahassāni, eko sāvakānaṃ sannipāto ahosi sattatibhikkhusahassāni, eko sāvakānaṃ sannipāto ahosi saṭṭhibhikkhusahassāni.
content: 一次弟子們的聚集有八萬比丘，一次弟子們的聚集有七萬比丘，一次弟子們的聚集有六萬比丘，

original: Vessabhussa, bhikkhave, bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa ime tayo sāvakānaṃ sannipātā ahesuṃ sabbesaṃyeva khīṇāsavānaṃ.
content: 比丘們！毘舍浮世尊、阿羅漢、遍正覺者的這三次弟子們的聚集全部都是漏已滅盡者。

original: ‘ ‘ Kakusandhassa, bhikkhave, bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa eko sāvakānaṃ sannipāto ahosi cattālīsabhikkhusahassāni.
content: 比丘們！拘留孫世尊、阿羅漢、遍正覺者有一次弟子們的聚集：四萬比丘，

original: Kakusandhassa, bhikkhave, bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa ayaṃ eko sāvakānaṃ sannipāto ahosi sabbesaṃyeva khīṇāsavānaṃ.
content: 比丘們！拘留孫世尊、阿羅漢、遍正覺者的這一次弟子們的聚集全部都是漏已滅盡者。

original: ‘ ‘ Koṇāgamanassa, bhikkhave, bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa eko sāvakānaṃ sannipāto ahosi tiṃsabhikkhusahassāni.
content: 比丘們！拘那含牟尼世尊、阿羅漢、遍正覺者有一次弟子們的聚集：三萬比丘，

original: Koṇāgamanassa, bhikkhave, bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa ayaṃ eko sāvakānaṃ sannipāto ahosi sabbesaṃyeva khīṇāsavānaṃ.
content: 比丘們！拘那含牟尼世尊、阿羅漢、遍正覺者的這一次弟子們的聚集全部都是漏已滅盡者。

original: ‘ ‘ Kassapassa, bhikkhave, bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa eko sāvakānaṃ sannipāto ahosi vīsatibhikkhusahassāni.
content: 比丘們！迦葉世尊、阿羅漢、遍正覺者有一次弟子們的聚集：二萬比丘，

original: Kassapassa, bhikkhave, bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa ayaṃ eko sāvakānaṃ sannipāto ahosi sabbesaṃyeva khīṇāsavānaṃ.
content: 比丘們！迦葉世尊、阿羅漢、遍正覺者的這一次弟子們的聚集全部都是漏已滅盡者。

original: ‘ ‘ Mayhaṃ, bhikkhave, etarahi eko sāvakānaṃ sannipāto ahosi aḍḍhateḷasāni bhikkhusatāni.
content: 比丘們！我現在有一次弟子們的聚集：一千二百五十比丘，

original: Mayhaṃ, bhikkhave, ayaṃ eko sāvakānaṃ sannipāto ahosi sabbesaṃyeva khīṇāsavānaṃ.
content: 我的這一次弟子們的聚集全部都是漏已滅盡者。(10)

original: 11.‘‘ Vipassissa, bhikkhave, bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa asoko nāma bhikkhu upaṭṭhāko ahosi aggupaṭṭhāko.
content: 比丘們！毘婆尸世尊、阿羅漢、遍正覺者的名為無憂比丘侍者是最上的侍者，

original: Sikhissa, bhikkhave, bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa khemaṅkaro nāma bhikkhu upaṭṭhāko ahosi aggupaṭṭhāko.
content: 比丘們！尸棄世尊、阿羅漢、遍正覺者的名為安穩作比丘侍者是最上的侍者，

original: Vessabhussa, bhikkhave, bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa upasanto nāma bhikkhu upaṭṭhāko ahosi aggupaṭṭhāko.
content: 比丘們！毘舍浮世尊、阿羅漢、遍正覺者的名為寂靜比丘侍者是最上的侍者，

original: Kakusandhassa, bhikkhave, bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa buddhijo nāma bhikkhu upaṭṭhāko ahosi aggupaṭṭhāko.
content: 比丘們！拘留孫世尊、阿羅漢、遍正覺者的名為覺生比丘侍者是最上的侍者，

original: Koṇāgamanassa, bhikkhave, bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa sotthijo nāma bhikkhu upaṭṭhāko ahosi aggupaṭṭhāko.
content: 比丘們！拘那含牟尼世尊、阿羅漢、遍正覺者的名為平安生比丘侍者是最上的侍者，

original: Kassapassa, bhikkhave, bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa sabbamitto nāma bhikkhu upaṭṭhāko ahosi aggupaṭṭhāko.
content: 比丘們！迦葉世尊、阿羅漢、遍正覺者的名為一切友比丘侍者是最上的侍者，

original: Mayhaṃ, bhikkhave, etarahi ānando nāma bhikkhu upaṭṭhāko ahosi aggupaṭṭhāko.
content: 比丘們！我現在的名為阿難比丘侍者是最上的侍者。(11)

original: 12.‘‘ Vipassissa, bhikkhave, bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa bandhumā nāma rājā pitā ahosi.
content: 比丘們！毘婆尸世尊、阿羅漢、遍正覺者的父親是名為邦都馬的國王，

original: Bandhumatī nāma devī mātā ahosi janetti[ janettī( syā.)].
content: 生母母親是名為邦都馬低的皇后，

original: Bandhumassa rañño bandhumatī nāma nagaraṃ rājadhānī ahosi.
content: 邦都馬國王的王都是名為邦都馬低的王都。

original: ‘ ‘ Sikhissa , bhikkhave, bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa aruṇo nāma rājā pitā ahosi.
content: 比丘們！尸棄世尊、阿羅漢、遍正覺者的父親是名為明相的國王，

original: Pabhāvatī nāma devī mātā ahosi janetti.
content: 生母母親是名為有光明的皇后，

original: Aruṇassa rañño aruṇavatī nāma nagaraṃ rājadhānī ahosi.
content: 明相國王的王都是名為有明相的王都。

original: ‘ ‘ Vessabhussa, bhikkhave, bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa suppatito nāma[ suppatīto nāma( syā.)] rājā pitā ahosi.
content: 比丘們！毘舍浮世尊、阿羅漢、遍正覺者的父親是名善降落的國王，

original: Vassavatī nāma[ yasavatī nāma( syā. pī.)] devī mātā ahosi janetti.
content: 生母母親是名為有雨的皇后，

original: Suppatitassa rañño anomaṃ nāma nagaraṃ rājadhānī ahosi.
content: 善降落國王的王都是名為優勝的王都。

original: ‘ ‘ Kakusandhassa, bhikkhave, bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa aggidatto nāma brāhmaṇo pitā ahosi.
content: 比丘們！拘留孫世尊、阿羅漢、遍正覺者的父親是名為火施的婆羅門，

original: Visākhā nāma brāhmaṇī mātā ahosi janetti.
content: 生母母親是名為枝條的婆羅門女，

original: Tena kho pana, bhikkhave, samayena khemo nāma rājā ahosi.
content: 比丘們！那時的國王名為安穩(差摩)，

original: Khemassa rañño khemavatī nāma nagaraṃ rājadhānī ahosi.
content: 安穩國王的王都是名為有安穩的王都。

original: ‘ ‘ Koṇāgamanassa, bhikkhave, bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa yaññadatto nāma brāhmaṇo pitā ahosi.
content: 比丘們！拘那含牟尼世尊、阿羅漢、遍正覺者的父親是名為犧牲施的婆羅門，

original: Uttarā nāma brāhmaṇī mātā ahosi janetti.
content: 生母母親是名為鬱多羅的婆羅門女，

original: Tena kho pana, bhikkhave, samayena sobho nāma rājā ahosi.
content: 比丘們！那時的國王名為淨潔，

original: Sobhassa rañño sobhavatī nāma nagaraṃ rājadhānī ahosi.
content: 淨潔國王的王都是名為有潔淨的王都。

original: ‘ ‘ Kassapassa, bhikkhave, bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa brahmadatto nāma brāhmaṇo pitā ahosi.
content: 比丘們！迦葉世尊、阿羅漢、遍正覺者的父親是名為梵施的婆羅門，

original: Dhanavatī nāma brāhmaṇī mātā ahosi janetti.
content: 生母母親是名為有財的婆羅門女，

original: Tena kho pana, bhikkhave, samayena kikī nāma[ kiṃ kī nāma( syā.)] rājā ahosi.
content: 比丘們！那時的國王名為居居，

original: Kikissa rañño bārāṇasī nāma nagaraṃ rājadhānī ahosi.
content: 居居國王的王都是名為波羅奈的王都。

original: ‘ ‘ Mayhaṃ, bhikkhave, etarahi suddhodano nāma rājā pitā ahosi.
content: 比丘們！我現在的父親是名為淨飯的國王，

original: Māyā nāma devī mātā ahosi janetti.
content: 生母母親是名為摩耶的皇后，

original: Kapilavatthu nāma nagaraṃ rājadhānī ahosī’’ ti.
content: 王都是名為迦毘羅衛的王都。

original: Idamavoca bhagavā, idaṃ vatvāna sugato uṭṭhāyāsanā vihāraṃ pāvisi.
content: 世尊說這個，說這個後，[[sugato#善逝]]從座位起來後進入住處。(12)

original: 13. Atha kho tesaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ acirapakkantassa bhagavato ayamantarākathā udapādi–
content: 那時，當世尊離開不久，那些比丘的這個談論中間出現：

original: ‘‘ acchariyaṃ, āvuso, abbhutaṃ, āvuso, tathāgatassa mahiddhikatā mahānubhāvatā.
content: 「不可思議啊！[[āvuso#學友]]們！[[abbhuta#未曾有]]啊！學友們！如來的大神通力狀態、大威力狀態：

original: Yatra hi nāma tathāgato atīte buddhe parinibbute chinnapapañce chinnavaṭume pariyādinnavaṭṭe sabbadukkhavītivatte jātitopi anussarissati, nāmatopi anussarissati, gottatopi anussarissati, āyuppamāṇatopi anussarissati, sāvakayugatopi anussarissati, sāvakasannipātatopi anussarissati–
content: 確實是因為如來在過去已[[parinibbānaṃ#般涅槃]]的、已切斷[[papañcaṃ#虛妄]]的、[[chinnapapañce chinnavaṭume#已切斷路徑]]的、已終結輪迴的、已超越一切苦的諸佛上將會回憶血統，也將會回憶名字，也將會回憶家系，也將會回憶壽命量，也將會回憶雙弟子，也將會回憶弟子們的聚集：

original: ‘ evaṃjaccā te bhagavanto ahesuṃ itipi, evaṃnāmā evaṃgottā evaṃsīlā evaṃdhammā evaṃpaññā evaṃvihārī evaṃvimuttā te bhagavanto ahesuṃ itipī’’’ ti.
content: 『那些世尊是這樣血統。』這樣姓氏者……這樣戒者……[[evaṃdhammā#這樣法者]]……這樣慧者……[[evaṃvihārī#這樣住處者]]……及『那些世尊是[[evaṃvimuttā#這樣解脫者]]。』

original: ‘ ‘ Kiṃ nu kho, āvuso, tathāgatasseva nu kho esā dhammadhātu suppaṭividdhā, yassā dhammadhātuyā suppaṭividdhattā tathāgato atīte buddhe parinibbute chinnapapañce chinnavaṭume pariyādinnavaṭṭe sabbadukkhavītivatte jātitopi anussarati, nāmatopi anussarati, gottatopi anussarati, āyuppamāṇatopi anussarati, sāvakayugatopi anussarati, sāvakasannipātatopi anussarati–
content: 學友們！究竟是如來的頗善通達的這個法界，以該法界的善通達狀態，如來在過去已般涅槃的、已切斷虛妄的、已切斷路徑的、已終結輪迴的、已超越一切苦的諸佛上回憶血統，也回憶名字，也回憶家系，也回憶壽命量，也回憶雙弟子，也回憶弟子們的聚集：

original: ‘ evaṃjaccā te bhagavanto ahesuṃ itipi, evaṃnāmā evaṃgottā evaṃsīlā evaṃdhammā evaṃpaññā evaṃvihārī evaṃvimuttā te bhagavanto ahesuṃ itipī’ ti, udāhu devatā tathāgatassa etamatthaṃ ārocesuṃ, yena tathāgato atīte buddhe parinibbute chinnapapañce chinnavaṭume pariyādinnavaṭṭe sabbadukkhavītivatte jātitopi anussarati, nāmatopi anussarati, gottatopi anussarati, āyuppamāṇatopi anussarati, sāvakayugatopi anussarati, sāvakasannipātatopi anussarati–
content: 『那些世尊是這樣血統。』這樣姓氏者……這樣戒者……這樣法者……這樣慧者……這樣的住處者……及『那些世尊是這樣的解脫者。』呢？或者，天神們告知如來這個義理，以那個，如來在過去已般涅槃的、已切斷虛妄的、已切斷路徑的、已終結輪迴的、已超越一切苦的諸佛上回憶血統，也回憶名字，也回憶家系，也回憶壽命量，也回憶雙弟子，也回憶弟子們的聚集：

original: ‘ evaṃjaccā te bhagavanto ahesuṃ itipi, evaṃnāmā evaṃgottā evaṃsīlā evaṃdhammā evaṃpaññā evaṃvihārī evaṃvimuttā te bhagavanto ahesuṃ itipī’’’ ti.
content: 『那些世尊是這樣血統。』這樣姓氏者……這樣戒者……這樣法者……這樣慧者……這樣的住處者……及『那些世尊是這樣的解脫者。』呢？」

original: Ayañca hidaṃ tesaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ antarākathā vippakatā hoti.
content: 但這件事，這個那些比丘的談論中間被中斷。(13)

original: 14. Atha kho bhagavā sāyanhasamayaṃ paṭisallānā vuṭṭhito yena karerimaṇḍalamāḷo tenupasaṅkami;
content: 那時，世尊[[sāyanhasamayaṃ#傍晚時]]，從[[paṭisallāṇa#獨坐]]出來，去花林圓亭棚。

original: upasaṅkamitvā paññatte āsane nisīdi.
content: 抵達後，世尊在設置的座位坐下，

original: Nisajja kho bhagavā bhikkhū āmantesi–
content: 坐下後，世尊召喚比丘們：

original: ‘‘ kāyanuttha, bhikkhave, etarahi kathāya sannisinnā;
content: 「比丘們！現在，在這裡為了什麼談論共坐聚集呢？

original: kā ca pana vo antarākathā vippakatā’’ ti?
content: 還有，你們的談論中間被中斷的是什麼？」

original: Evaṃ vutte te bhikkhū bhagavantaṃ etadavocuṃ–
content: 在這麼說時，那些比丘對世尊說這個：

original: ‘‘ idha, bhante, amhākaṃ acirapakkantassa bhagavato ayaṃ antarākathā udapādi–
content: 「大德！這裡，當世尊離開不久，我們的這個談論中間出現：

original: ‘ acchariyaṃ, āvuso, abbhutaṃ, āvuso, tathāgatassa mahiddhikatā mahānubhāvatā, yatra hi nāma tathāgato atīte buddhe parinibbute chinnapapañce chinnavaṭume pariyādinnavaṭṭe sabbadukkhavītivatte jātitopi anussarissati, nāmatopi anussarissati, gottatopi anussarissati, āyuppamāṇatopi anussarissati, sāvakayugatopi anussarissati, sāvakasannipātatopi anussarissati–
content: 『不可思議啊！學友們！未曾有啊！學友們！如來的大神通力狀態、大威力狀態：確實是因為如來在過去已般涅槃、已切斷虛妄、已切斷路徑、已終結輪迴、已超越一切苦諸佛上將會回憶血統，也將會回憶名字，也將會回憶家系，也將會回憶壽命量，也將會回憶雙弟子，也將會回憶弟子們的聚集：

original: ‘‘ evaṃjaccā te bhagavanto ahesuṃ itipi , evaṃnāmā evaṃgottā evaṃsīlā evaṃdhammā evaṃpaññā evaṃvihārī evaṃvimuttā te bhagavanto ahesuṃ itipī’’ ti.
content: 「那些世尊是這樣血統。」及這樣名字、這樣姓氏、這樣戒、這樣法者……這樣慧者……這樣住處者……「那些世尊是這樣解脫者。」

original: Kiṃ nu kho, āvuso, tathāgatasseva nu kho esā dhammadhātu suppaṭividdhā, yassā dhammadhātuyā suppaṭividdhattā tathāgato atīte buddhe parinibbute chinnapapañce chinnavaṭume pariyādinnavaṭṭe sabbadukkhavītivatte jātitopi anussarati, nāmatopi anussarati, gottatopi anussarati, āyuppamāṇatopi anussarati, sāvakayugatopi anussarati, sāvakasannipātatopi anussarati–
content: 學友們！究竟是如來的頗善通達的這個法界，以該法界的善通達狀態，如來在過去已般涅槃的、已切斷虛妄的、已切斷路徑的、已終結輪迴的、已超越一切苦的諸佛上回憶血統，也回憶名字，也回憶家系，也回憶壽命量，也回憶雙弟子，也回憶弟子們的聚集：

original: ‘‘ evaṃjaccā te bhagavanto ahesuṃ itipi, evaṃnāmā evaṃgottā evaṃsīlā evaṃdhammā evaṃpaññā evaṃvihārī evaṃvimuttā te bhagavanto ahesuṃ itipī’’ ti.
content: 「那些世尊是這樣血統。』這樣姓氏者……這樣戒者……這樣法者……這樣慧者……這樣的住處者……及『那些世尊是這樣的解脫者。」呢？

original: Udāhu devatā tathāgatassa etamatthaṃ ārocesuṃ, yena tathāgato atīte buddhe parinibbute chinnapapañce chinnavaṭume pariyādinnavaṭṭe sabbadukkhavītivatte jātitopi anussarati, nāmatopi anussarati, gottatopi anussarati, āyuppamāṇatopi anussarati, sāvakayugatopi anussarati, sāvakasannipātatopi anussarati–
content: 或者，天神們告知如來這個義理，以那個，如來在過去已般涅槃的、已切斷虛妄的、已切斷路徑的、已終結輪迴的、已超越一切苦的諸佛上回憶血統，也回憶名字，也回憶家系，也回憶壽命量，也回憶雙弟子，也回憶弟子們的聚集：

original: ‘ evaṃjaccā te bhagavanto ahesuṃ itipi, evaṃnāmā evaṃgottā evaṃsīlā evaṃdhammā evaṃpaññā evaṃvihārī evaṃvimuttā te bhagavanto ahesuṃ itipī’ ti?
content: 「那些世尊是這樣血統。」這樣姓氏者……這樣戒者……這樣法者……這樣慧者……這樣的住處者……及『那些世尊是這樣的解脫者。』呢？」』

original: Ayaṃ kho no, bhante, antarākathā vippakatā, atha bhagavā anuppatto’’ ti.
content: 大德！這是我們的談論中間被中斷的，然後世尊抵達。」(14)

original: 15.‘‘ Tathāgatassevesā, bhikkhave, dhammadhātu suppaṭividdhā, yassā dhammadhātuyā suppaṭividdhattā tathāgato atīte buddhe parinibbute chinnapapañce chinnavaṭume pariyādinnavaṭṭe sabbadukkhavītivatte jātitopi anussarati, nāmatopi anussarati, gottatopi anussarati, āyuppamāṇatopi anussarati, sāvakayugatopi anussarati, sāvakasannipātatopi anussarati–
content: 「比丘們！如來的頗善通達的這個法界，以該法界的善通達狀態，如來在過去已般涅槃的、已切斷虛妄的、已切斷路徑的、已終結輪迴的、已超越一切苦的諸佛上回憶血統，也回憶名字，也回憶家系，也回憶壽命量，也回憶雙弟子，也回憶弟子們的聚集：

original: ‘ evaṃjaccā te bhagavanto ahesuṃ itipi, evaṃnāmā evaṃgottā evaṃsīlā evaṃdhammā evaṃpaññā evaṃvihārī evaṃvimuttā te bhagavanto ahesuṃ itipī’ ti.
content: 「那些世尊是這樣血統。』這樣姓氏者……這樣戒者……這樣法者……這樣慧者……這樣的住處者……及『那些世尊是這樣的解脫者。』

original: Devatāpi tathāgatassa etamatthaṃ ārocesuṃ, yena tathāgato atīte buddhe parinibbute chinnapapañce chinnavaṭume pariyādinnavaṭṭe sabbadukkhavītivatte jātitopi anussarati, nāmatopi anussarati, gottatopi anussarati, āyuppamāṇatopi anussarati, sāvakayugatopi anussarati, sāvakasannipātatopi anussarati–
content: 天神們也告知如來這個義理，以那個，如來在過去已般涅槃的、已切斷虛妄的、已切斷路徑的、已終結輪迴的、已超越一切苦的諸佛上回憶血統，也回憶名字，也回憶家系，也回憶壽命量，也回憶雙弟子，也回憶弟子們的聚集：

original: ‘ evaṃjaccā te bhagavanto ahesuṃ itipi, evaṃnāmā evaṃgottā evaṃsīlā evaṃdhammā evaṃpaññā evaṃvihārī evaṃvimuttā te bhagavanto ahesuṃ itipī’ ti.
content: 「那些世尊是這樣血統。」這樣姓氏者……這樣戒者……這樣法者……這樣慧者……這樣的住處者……及『那些世尊是這樣的解脫者。』

original: ‘ ‘ Iccheyyātha no tumhe, bhikkhave, bhiyyosomattāya pubbenivāsapaṭisaṃyuttaṃ dhammiṃ kathaṃ sotun’’ ti?
content: 比丘們！你們會想要更進一步聽聞前世住處關聯的法的談論嗎？」

original: ‘‘ Etassa, bhagavā, kālo;
content: 「世尊！是為了這個的適當時機，

original: etassa, sugata, kālo;
content: 善逝！是為了這個的適當時機：

original: yaṃ bhagavā bhiyyosomattāya pubbenivāsapaṭisaṃyuttaṃ dhammiṃ kathaṃ kareyya, bhagavato sutvā bhikkhū dhāressantī’’ ti.
content: 凡如果世尊更進一步作前世住處關聯的法的談論，聽聞世尊的[教說]後，比丘們將會憶持。」

original: ‘‘ Tena hi, bhikkhave , suṇātha, sādhukaṃ manasi karotha, bhāsissāmī’’ ti.
content: 「比丘們！那樣的話，你們要聽！你們要好好作意！我將說。」

original: ‘‘ Evaṃ, bhante’’ ti kho te bhikkhū bhagavato paccassosuṃ.
content: 「是的，大德！」那些比丘回答世尊。

original: Bhagavā etadavoca–
content: 世尊說這個：(15)

original: 16.‘‘ Ito so, bhikkhave, ekanavutikappe yaṃ vipassī bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho loke udapādi.
content: 「比丘們！在九十一劫前，凡毘婆尸世尊、阿羅漢、遍正覺者在世間出現。

original: Vipassī, bhikkhave, bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho khattiyo jātiyā ahosi, khattiyakule udapādi.
content: 比丘們！毘婆尸世尊、阿羅漢、遍正覺者是剎帝利血統，出生在剎帝利家。

original: Vipassī, bhikkhave, bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho koṇḍañño gottena ahosi.
content: 比丘們！毘婆尸世尊、阿羅漢、遍正覺者姓憍陳如。

original: Vipassissa, bhikkhave, bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa asītivassasahassāni āyuppamāṇaṃ ahosi.
content: 比丘們！毘婆尸世尊、阿羅漢、遍正覺者的壽命量是八萬年。

original: Vipassī, bhikkhave, bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho pāṭaliyā mūle abhisambuddho.
content: 比丘們！毘婆尸世尊、阿羅漢、遍正覺者在波吒釐樹下現正覺。

original: Vipassissa, bhikkhave , bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa khaṇḍatissaṃ nāma sāvakayugaṃ ahosi aggaṃ bhaddayugaṃ.
content: 比丘們！毘婆尸世尊、阿羅漢、遍正覺者名為騫茶、低舍雙弟子是最上的雙賢。

original: Vipassissa, bhikkhave, bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa tayo sāvakānaṃ sannipātā ahesuṃ.
content: 比丘們！毘婆尸世尊、阿羅漢、遍正覺者有三次弟子們的聚集：

original: Eko sāvakānaṃ sannipāto ahosi aṭṭhasaṭṭhibhikkhusatasahassaṃ, eko sāvakānaṃ sannipāto ahosi bhikkhusatasahassaṃ, eko sāvakānaṃ sannipāto ahosi asītibhikkhusahassāni.
content: 一次弟子們的聚集有六百八十萬比丘，一次弟子們的聚集有十萬比丘，一次弟子們的聚集有八萬比丘，

original: Vipassissa, bhikkhave, bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa ime tayo sāvakānaṃ sannipātā ahesuṃ sabbesaṃyeva khīṇāsavānaṃ.
content: 比丘們！毘婆尸世尊、阿羅漢、遍正覺者的這三次弟子們的聚集全部都是漏已滅盡者。

original: Vipassissa, bhikkhave, bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa asoko nāma bhikkhu upaṭṭhāko ahosi aggupaṭṭhāko.
content: 比丘們！毘婆尸世尊、阿羅漢、遍正覺者的名為無憂比丘侍者是最上的侍者。

original: Vipassissa, bhikkhave, bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa bandhumā nāma rājā pitā ahosi.
content: 比丘們！毘婆尸世尊、阿羅漢、遍正覺者的父親是名為邦都馬的國王，

original: Bandhumatī nāma devī mātā ahosi janetti.
content: 生母母親是名為邦都馬低的皇后，

original: Bandhumassa rañño bandhumatī nāma nagaraṃ rājadhānī ahosi.
content: 邦都馬國王的王都是名為邦都馬低的王都。(16)

original: Bodhisattadhammatā
content: 菩薩常法

original: 17.‘‘ Atha kho, bhikkhave, vipassī bodhisatto tusitā kāyā cavitvā sato sampajāno mātukucchiṃ okkami.
content: 比丘們！那時，毘婆尸菩薩從兜率天死沒後，具念地、正知地進入母親子宮[MN.123]。

original: Ayamettha dhammatā.
content: 在這裡，這是常法。(17)

original: 18.‘‘ Dhammatā, esā, bhikkhave, yadā bodhisatto tusitā kāyā cavitvā mātukucchiṃ okkamati.
content: 比丘們！這是常法：當菩薩從兜率天死沒後進入母親子宮時，

original: Atha sadevake loke samārake sabrahmake sassamaṇabrāhmaṇiyā pajāya sadevamanussāya appamāṇo uḷāro obhāso pātubhavati atikkammeva devānaṃ devānubhāvaṃ.
content: 那時，在包括天、魔、梵的世間；包括沙門婆羅門，包括天-人的[[pajāya#世代]]中，就超越諸天的天威後，無量偉大的光明在世間出現，

original: Yāpi tā lokantarikā aghā asaṃvutā andhakārā andhakāratimisā , yattha pime candimasūriyā evaṃmahiddhikā evaṃmahānubhāvā ābhāya nānubhonti, tatthapi appamāṇo uḷāro obhāso pātubhavati atikkammeva devānaṃ devānubhāvaṃ.
content: 凡即使那些[[lokantarikā aghā asaṃvutā#世界中間空無防護的]]、暗黑的、黑暗的黑夜的，於該處，這些這麼大神通力、這麼大威力日月以光明也不經歷，在那裡，就超越諸天的天威後，也有無量偉大的光明在世間出現。

original: Yepi tattha sattā upapannā, tepi tenobhāsena aññamaññaṃ sañjānanti–
content: 又，凡在那裡往生的眾生，他們也以那個光明相互[[sañjānāti#認知]]：

original: ‘ aññepi kira, bho, santi sattā idhūpapannā’ ti.
content: 『[[bho#先生]]！在這裡往生的其他眾生確實也存在。』

original: Ayañca dasasahassī lokadhātu saṅkampati sampakampati sampavedhati.
content: 這個十千世界震動、大震動、激烈震動，

original: Appamāṇo ca uḷāro obhāso loke pātubhavati atikkammeva devānaṃ devānubhāvaṃ.
content: 以及就超越諸天的天威後，無量神聖的光明在世間出現。

original: Ayamettha dhammatā.
content: 在這裡，這是常法。(18)

original: 19.‘‘ Dhammatā esā, bhikkhave, yadā bodhisatto mātukucchiṃ okkanto hoti, cattāro naṃ devaputtā catuddisaṃ[ cātuddisaṃ( syā.)] rakkhāya upagacchanti–
content: 比丘們！這是常法：當菩薩進入母親子宮時，四位天子為四方的守護到達，

original: ‘ mā naṃ bodhisattaṃ vā bodhisattamātaraṃ vā manusso vā amanusso vā koci vā viheṭhesī’ ti.
content: 不要人或[[amanussā#非人]]或任何東西加害那位菩薩或菩薩的母親。

original: Ayamettha dhammatā.
content: 在這裡，這是常法。(19)

original: 20.‘‘ Dhammatā esā, bhikkhave, yadā bodhisatto mātukucchiṃ okkanto hoti, pakatiyā sīlavatī bodhisattamātā hoti, viratā pāṇātipātā, viratā adinnādānā, viratā kāmesumicchācārā , viratā musāvādā, viratā surāmerayamajjappamādaṭṭhānā.
content: 比丘們！這是常法：當菩薩進入母親子宮時，菩薩的母親自然地成為持戒者：離殺生，離[[adinnādānā#未被給與的拿取]]，離[[kāmesumicchācārā#邪淫]]，離[[musāvādā#妄語]]，離榖酒、果酒、[[surāmerayamajjapamādaṭṭhānā#酒放逸處]]。

original: Ayamettha dhammatā.
content: 在這裡，這是常法。(20)

original: 21.‘‘ Dhammatā esā, bhikkhave, yadā bodhisatto mātukucchiṃ okkanto hoti, na bodhisattamātu purisesu mānasaṃ uppajjati kāmaguṇūpasaṃhitaṃ, anatikkamanīyā ca bodhisattamātā hoti kenaci purisena rattacittena.
content: 比丘們！這是常法：當菩薩進入母親子宮時，菩薩的母親不在男子上生起伴隨欲類的心意，以及菩薩的母親不能被任何染心的男子征服。

original: Ayamettha dhammatā.
content: 在這裡，這是常法。(21)

original: 22.‘‘ Dhammatā esā, bhikkhave, yadā bodhisatto mātukucchiṃ okkanto hoti, lābhinī bodhisattamātā hoti pañcannaṃ kāmaguṇānaṃ.
content: 比丘們！這是常法：當菩薩進入母親子宮時，菩薩的母親是得到[[pañca kāmaguṇā#五種欲]]者，

original: Sā pañcahi kāmaguṇehi samappitā samaṅgībhūtā paricāreti.
content: 她賦有、擁有五種欲自娛。

original: Ayamettha dhammatā.
content: 在這裡，這是常法。(22)

original: 23.‘‘ Dhammatā esā, bhikkhave, yadā bodhisatto mātukucchiṃ okkanto hoti, na bodhisattamātu kocideva ābādho uppajjati.
content: 比丘們！這是常法：當菩薩進入母親子宮時，菩薩的母親就不生任何病，

original: Sukhinī bodhisattamātā hoti akilantakāyā, bodhisattañca bodhisattamātā tirokucchigataṃ passati sabbaṅgapaccaṅgiṃ ahīnindriyaṃ.
content: 菩薩的母親是有樂者、身體不疲倦者。菩薩的母親穿過子宮地看見全部大小肢體的、不缺諸根的菩薩，

original: Seyyathāpi, bhikkhave, maṇi veḷuriyo subho jātimā aṭṭhaṃso suparikammakato accho vippasanno anāvilo sabbākārasampanno.
content: 比丘們！猶如美麗的、純正的、八個切割面的、作工細緻的琉璃寶珠，

original: Tatrāssa[ tatrassa( syā.)] suttaṃ āvutaṃ nīlaṃ vā pītaṃ vā lohitaṃ vā odātaṃ vā paṇḍusuttaṃ vā.
content: 在那裡，它被藍或黃或紅或白或淡黃線綁住，

original: Tamenaṃ cakkhumā puriso hatthe karitvā paccavekkheyya–
content: 有眼男子放置它在手掌上後省察：

original: ‘ ayaṃ kho maṇi veḷuriyo subho jātimā aṭṭhaṃso suparikammakato accho vippasanno anāvilo sabbākārasampanno.
content: 『這個是美麗的、純正的、八個切割面的、作工細緻的琉璃寶珠，

original: Tatridaṃ suttaṃ āvutaṃ nīlaṃ vā pītaṃ vā lohitaṃ vā odātaṃ vā paṇḍusuttaṃ vā’ ti.
content: 在那裡，它被藍或黃或紅或白或淡黃線綁住。』

original: Evameva kho, bhikkhave, yadā bodhisatto mātukucchiṃ okkanto hoti, na bodhisattamātu kocideva ābādho uppajjati, sukhinī bodhisattamātā hoti akilantakāyā , bodhisattañca bodhisattamātā tirokucchigataṃ passati sabbaṅgapaccaṅgiṃ ahīnindriyaṃ.
content: 同樣的，比丘們！當菩薩進入母親子宮時，菩薩的母親就不生任何病，菩薩的母親是有樂者、身體不疲倦者。菩薩的母親穿過子宮地看見全部大小肢體的、不缺諸根的菩薩。

original: Ayamettha dhammatā.
content: 在這裡，這是常法。(23)

original: 24.‘‘ Dhammatā esā, bhikkhave, sattāhajāte bodhisatte bodhisattamātā kālaṅkaroti tusitaṃ kāyaṃ upapajjati.
content: 比丘們！這是常法：在菩薩已出生七天，菩薩的母親命終，往生兜率天身。

original: Ayamettha dhammatā.
content: 在這裡，這是常法。(24)

original: 25.‘‘ Dhammatā esā, bhikkhave, yathā aññā itthikā nava vā dasa vā māse gabbhaṃ kucchinā pariharitvā vijāyanti, na hevaṃ bodhisattaṃ bodhisattamātā vijāyati.
content: 比丘們！這是常法：如其他女子們以子宮照顧胎兒九或十個月後生產，菩薩的母親不這樣生產菩薩，

original: Daseva māsāni bodhisattaṃ bodhisattamātā kucchinā pariharitvā vijāyati.
content: 菩薩的母親以子宮照顧胎兒整十個月後生產菩薩。

original: Ayamettha dhammatā.
content: 在這裡，這是常法。(25)

original: 26.‘‘ Dhammatā esā, bhikkhave, yathā aññā itthikā nisinnā vā nipannā vā vijāyanti, na hevaṃ bodhisattaṃ bodhisattamātā vijāyati.
content: 比丘們！這是常法：如其他女子們坐著或躺著生產，菩薩的母親不這樣生產菩薩，

original: Ṭhitāva bodhisattaṃ bodhisattamātā vijāyati.
content: 菩薩的母親就站著生產菩薩。

original: Ayamettha dhammatā.
content: 在這裡，這是常法。(26)

original: 27.‘‘ Dhammatā esā, bhikkhave, yadā bodhisatto mātukucchimhā nikkhamati, devā paṭhamaṃ paṭiggaṇhanti, pacchā manussā.
content: 比丘們！這是常法：當菩薩出母親子宮時，天神們先接他，後人們。

original: Ayamettha dhammatā.
content: 在這裡，這是常法。(27)

original: 28.‘‘ Dhammatā esā, bhikkhave, yadā bodhisatto mātukucchimhā nikkhamati, appattova bodhisatto pathaviṃ hoti, cattāro naṃ devaputtā paṭiggahetvā mātu purato ṭhapenti–
content: 比丘們！這是常法：當菩薩出母親子宮時，菩薩還未到達地面，四位天子接他後，安置在母親前：

original: ‘ attamanā, devi, hohi;
content: 『皇后！請妳成為喜悅者，

original: mahesakkho te putto uppanno’ ti.
content: 你的大影響力兒子已出生。』

original: Ayamettha dhammatā.
content: 在這裡，這是常法。(28)

original: 29.‘‘ Dhammatā esā, bhikkhave, yadā bodhisatto mātukucchimhā nikkhamati, visadova nikkhamati amakkhito udena[ uddena( syā.), udarena( katthaci)] amakkhito semhena amakkhito ruhirena amakkhito kenaci asucinā suddho[ visuddho( syā.)] visado.
content: 比丘們！這是常法：當菩薩出母親子宮時，就明淨地出來：沒被水沾污，沒被粘液沾污，沒被血液沾污，沒被任何不淨的沾污，是純淨的、明淨的，

original: Seyyathāpi, bhikkhave, maṇiratanaṃ kāsike vatthe nikkhittaṃ neva maṇiratanaṃ kāsikaṃ vatthaṃ makkheti, nāpi kāsikaṃ vatthaṃ maṇiratanaṃ makkheti.
content: 比丘們！猶如珠寶被放置在迦尸布上，珠寶既沒沾污迦尸布，迦尸布也沒沾污珠寶，

original: Taṃ kissa hetu?
content: 那是什麼原因？

original: Ubhinnaṃ suddhattā.
content: 兩者的純淨狀態。

original: Evameva kho, bhikkhave, yadā bodhisatto mātukucchimhā nikkhamati, visadova nikkhamati amakkhito, udena amakkhito semhena amakkhito ruhirena amakkhito kenaci asucinā suddho visado.
content: 同樣的，比丘們！當菩薩出母親子宮時，就明淨地出來：沒被水沾污，沒被粘液沾污，沒被血液沾污，沒被任何不淨的沾污，是純淨的、明淨的。

original: Ayamettha dhammatā.
content: 在這裡，這是常法。(29)

original: 30.‘‘ Dhammatā esā, bhikkhave, yadā bodhisatto mātukucchimhā nikkhamati, dve udakassa dhārā antalikkhā pātubhavanti– ekā sītassa ekā uṇhassa yena bodhisattassa udakakiccaṃ karonti mātu ca.
content: 比丘們！這是常法：當菩薩出母親子宮時，兩道水流從空中出現：一冷一熱，以那個對菩薩與母親作水洗。

original: Ayamettha dhammatā.
content: 在這裡，這是常法。(30)

original: 31.‘‘ Dhammatā esā, bhikkhave, sampatijāto bodhisatto samehi pādehi patiṭṭhahitvā uttarābhimukho[ uttarenābhimukho( syā.) uttarenamukho( ka.)] sattapadavītihārena gacchati setamhi chatte anudhāriyamāne, sabbā ca disā anuviloketi, āsabhiṃ vācaṃ bhāsati‘ aggohamasmi lokassa, jeṭṭhohamasmi lokassa, seṭṭhohamasmi lokassa, ayamantimā jāti, natthidāni punabbhavo’ ti.
content: 比丘們！這是常法：剛出生的菩薩平均地以兩腳住立在地上後，在被白色傘跟隨撐著下，面朝北交換走七步，環視全部方位，以及說如牛王的言語：『我是世間的最高者，我是世間的最勝者，我是世間的最上者，這是最後的岀生，現在，沒有再有。』

original: Ayamettha dhammatā.
content: 在這裡，這是常法。(31)

original: 32.‘‘ Dhammatā esā, bhikkhave, yadā bodhisatto mātukucchimhā nikkhamati, atha sadevake loke samārake sabrahmake sassamaṇabrāhmaṇiyā pajāya sadevamanussāya appamāṇo uḷāro obhāso pātubhavati, atikkammeva devānaṃ devānubhāvaṃ.
content: 比丘們！這是常法：當菩薩出母親子宮時，那時，包括天、魔、梵的世間；包括沙門婆羅門，包括天-人的世代中，就超越諸天的天威後，無量偉大的光明在世間出現，

original: Yāpi tā lokantarikā aghā asaṃvutā andhakārā andhakāratimisā, yattha pime candimasūriyā evaṃmahiddhikā evaṃmahānubhāvā ābhāya nānubhonti, tatthapi appamāṇo uḷāro obhāso pātubhavati atikkammeva devānaṃ devānubhāvaṃ.
content: 凡即使那些世界中間空無防護的、暗黑的、黑暗的黑夜的，於該處，這些這麼大神通力、這麼大威力日月以光明也不經歷，在那裡，就超越諸天的天威後，也有無量偉大的光明在世間出現。

original: Yepi tattha sattā upapannā, tepi tenobhāsena aññamaññaṃ sañjānanti–
content: 又，凡在那裡往生的眾生，他們也以那個光明相互認知：

original: ‘ aññepi kira, bho, santi sattā idhūpapannā’ ti.
content: 「先生！在這裡往生的其他眾生確實也存在。」

original: Ayañca dasasahassī lokadhātu saṅkampati sampakampati sampavedhati appamāṇo ca uḷāro obhāso loke pātubhavati atikkammeva devānaṃ devānubhāvaṃ.
content: 這個十千世界震動、大震動、激烈震動，以及就超越諸天的天威後，無量神聖的光明在世間出現。

original: Ayamettha dhammatā.
content: 在這裡，這是常法。(32)

original: Dvattiṃsamahāpurisalakkhaṇā
content: 三十二大丈夫相

original: 33.‘‘ Jāte kho pana, bhikkhave, vipassimhi kumāre bandhumato rañño paṭivedesuṃ–
content: 比丘們！在毘婆尸王子出生時，他們報告邦都馬國王：

original: ‘ putto te, deva[ deva te( ka.)], jāto, taṃ devo passatū’ ti.
content: 『陛下！你的兒子已出生，請陛下看他。』

original: Addasā kho, bhikkhave, bandhumā rājā vipassiṃ kumāraṃ, disvā nemitte brāhmaṇe āmantāpetvā etadavoca–
content: 比丘們！邦都馬國王看毘婆尸王子。看見後，使召喚占相婆羅門們後，說這個：

original: ‘ passantu bhonto nemittā brāhmaṇā kumāran’ ti.
content: 『請占相婆羅門尊師們看王子。』

original: Addasaṃsu kho, bhikkhave, nemittā brāhmaṇā vipassiṃ kumāraṃ, disvā bandhumantaṃ rājānaṃ etadavocuṃ–
content: 比丘們！占相婆羅門們看毘婆尸王子。看見後，對邦都馬國王說這個：

original: ‘ attamano, deva, hohi, mahesakkho te putto uppanno, lābhā te, mahārāja, suladdhaṃ te, mahārāja, yassa te kule evarūpo putto uppanno.
content: 『陛下！請你成為喜悅者，你的大影響力兒子已出生，大王！是你的利得，大王！[[suladdhaṃ te#是你的善得的]]：凡在你的家中像這樣的男孩已出生，

original: Ayañhi, deva, kumāro dvattiṃsamahāpurisalakkhaṇehi samannāgato, yehi samannāgatassa mahāpurisassa dveva gatiyo bhavanti anaññā.
content: 陛下！因為這位王子具備三十二[[mahāpuriso#大丈夫相]]，凡具備大丈夫相者，只有二個趣處，無其它的：

original: Sace agāraṃ ajjhāvasati, rājā hoti cakkavattī dhammiko dhammarājā cāturanto vijitāvī janapadatthāvariyappatto sattaratanasamannāgato.
content: 如果居住俗家，是轉輪王、[[dhammiko dhammarājā#如法法王]]、征服四邊者、達到國土安定者、具備七寶者。

original: Tassimāni sattaratanāni bhavanti.
content: 他有這七寶，

original: Seyyathidaṃ– cakkaratanaṃ hatthiratanaṃ assaratanaṃ maṇiratanaṃ itthiratanaṃ gahapatiratanaṃ pariṇāyakaratanameva sattamaṃ.
content: 即：輪寶、象寶、馬寶、珠寶、女寶、屋主寶，主兵臣寶正是第七的。

original: Parosahassaṃ kho panassa puttā bhavanti sūrā vīraṅgarūpā parasenappamaddanā.
content: 又他有超過千位勇敢的、英雄樣子的、碎破敵對者的兒子，

original: So imaṃ pathaviṃ sāgarapariyantaṃ adaṇḍena asatthena dhammena abhivijiya ajjhāvasati.
content: 他以非棍棒，以非刀劍，以法征服海洋為邊界的這個土地後居住；

original: Sace kho pana agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajati, arahaṃ hoti sammāsambuddho loke vivaṭacchado.
content: 但，如果[[saddhā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajitā#從在家出家成為無家者]]，是阿羅漢、遍正覺者、掀開世間中面紗者。(33)

original: 34.‘ Katamehi cāyaṃ, deva, kumāro dvattiṃsamahāpurisalakkhaṇehi samannāgato, yehi samannāgatassa mahāpurisassa dveva gatiyo bhavanti anaññā.
content: 陛下，這位王子具備哪三十二大丈夫相，凡具備大丈夫相者，只有二個趣處，無其它的：

original: Sace agāraṃ ajjhāvasati, rājā hoti cakkavattī dhammiko dhammarājā cāturanto vijitāpī janapadatthāvariyappatto sattaratanasamannāgato.
content: 如果居住俗家，是轉輪王、如法法王、征服四邊者、達到國土安定者、具備七寶者。

original: Tassimāni sattaratanāni bhavanti .
content: 他有這七寶，

original: Seyyathidaṃ– cakkaratanaṃ hatthiratanaṃ assaratanaṃ maṇiratanaṃ itthiratanaṃ gahapatiratanaṃ pariṇāyakaratanameva sattamaṃ.
content: 即：輪寶、象寶、馬寶、珠寶、女寶、屋主寶，主兵臣寶正是第七的。

original: Parosahassaṃ kho panassa puttā bhavanti sūrā vīraṅgarūpā parasenappamaddanā.
content: 又他有超過千位勇敢的、英雄樣子的、碎破敵對者的兒子，

original: So imaṃ pathaviṃ sāgarapariyantaṃ adaṇḍena asatthena dhammena abhivijiya ajjhāvasati.
content: 他以非棍棒，以非刀劍，以法征服海洋為邊界的這個土地後居住；

original: Sace kho pana agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajati, arahaṃ hoti sammāsambuddho loke vivaṭacchado.
content: 但，如果從在家出家成為無家者，是阿羅漢、遍正覺者、掀開世間中面紗者呢？(34)

original: 35.‘ Ayañhi, deva, kumāro suppatiṭṭhitapādo.
content: 陛下！這位王子有扁平足。

original: Yaṃ pāyaṃ, deva, kumāro suppatiṭṭhitapādo.
content: 陛下！又，凡這位王子有扁平足。

original: Idampissa mahāpurisassa mahāpurisalakkhaṇaṃ bhavati.
content: 陛下！這是大丈夫的大丈夫相。

original: ‘ Imassa, deva[ imassa hi deva(?)], kumārassa heṭṭhā pādatalesu cakkāni jātāni sahassārāni sanemikāni sanābhikāni sabbākāraparipūrāni.
content: 陛下！在這位王子的腳掌下面生有輪子：一千個輻條，有輪框，有輪軸圓心，全部完整的相貌。

original: Yampi, imassa deva, kumārassa heṭṭhā pādatalesu cakkāni jātāni sahassārāni sanemikāni sanābhikāni sabbākāraparipūrāni, idampissa mahāpurisassa mahāpurisalakkhaṇaṃ bhavati.
content: 陛下！又，凡在這位王子的腳掌下面生有輪子：一千個輻條，有輪框，有輪軸圓心，全部完整的相貌，陛下！這也是大丈夫的大丈夫相。

original: ‘ Ayañhi deva, kumāro āyatapaṇhī… pe…
content: 陛下！這位王子有廣長腳後跟的……。

original: ‘ Ayañhi, deva, kumāro dīghaṅgulī…
content: 陛下！這位王子有長手指的……。

original: ‘ Ayañhi, deva, kumāro mudutalunahatthapādo…
content: 陛下！這位王子有柔嫩手腳的……。

original: ‘ Ayañhi, deva kumāro jālahatthapādo…
content: 陛下！這位王子有網狀手腳的……。

original: ‘ Ayañhi, deva, kumāro ussaṅkhapādo…
content: 陛下！這位王子有高腳踝的……。

original: ‘ Ayañhi, deva, kumāro eṇijaṅgho…
content: 陛下！這位王子有鹿小腿的……。

original: ‘ Ayañhi, deva, kumāro ṭhitakova anonamanto ubhohi pāṇitalehi jaṇṇukāni parimasati[ parāmasati( ka.)] parimajjati…
content: 陛下！這位王子當不彎曲時就站立的以兩手掌觸摸、碰觸兩膝……。

original: ‘ Ayañhi , deva, kumāro kosohitavatthaguyho…
content: 陛下！這位王子有[[kosohitaṃ vatthaguyhaṃ#隱藏入鞘的陰部]]……。

original: ‘ Ayañhi, deva, kumāro suvaṇṇavaṇṇo kañcanasannibhattaco…
content: 陛下！這位王子有黃金容色的，如黃金皮膚的……。

original: ‘ Ayañhi, deva, kumāro sukhumacchavī;
content: 陛下！這位王子有細滑皮膚的，

original: sukhumattā chaviyā rajojallaṃ kāye na upalimpati[ upalippati( syā.)]…
content: 以皮膚的細滑狀態塵垢不沾染在身上……。

original: ‘ Ayañhi, deva, kumāro ekekalomo;
content: 陛下！這位王子有單獨體毛的，

original: ekekāni lomāni lomakūpesu jātāni…
content: 單獨的體毛被生在毛孔中……。

original: ‘ Ayañhi, deva, kumāro uddhaggalomo;
content: 陛下！這位王子有豎立體毛的，

original: uddhaggāni lomāni jātāni nīlāni añjanavaṇṇāni kuṇḍalāvaṭṭāni dakkhiṇāvaṭṭakajātāni…
content: 所生的豎立體毛是藍黑色的，環狀旋轉的，右旋轉生起的……。

original: ‘ Ayañhi, deva, kumāro brahmujugatto…
content: 陛下！這位王子有梵天端直身體的……。

original: ‘ Ayañhi, deva, kumāro sattussado…
content: 陛下！這位王子有七處隆滿的……。

original: ‘ Ayañhi , deva, kumāro sīhapubbaddhakāyo…
content: 陛下！這位王子有獅子上半身的……。

original: ‘ Ayañhi, deva, kumāro citantaraṃso[ pitantaraṃso( syā.)]…
content: 陛下！這位王子有兩肩之間飽滿的……。

original: ‘ Ayañhi, deva, kumāro nigrodhaparimaṇḍalo yāvatakvassa kāyo tāvatakvassa byāmo, yāvatakvassa byāmo, tāvatakvassa kāyo…
content: 陛下！這位王子有榕樹圓形的：他的身高同他的兩手伸展的長度；他的兩手伸展的長度同他的身高……。

original: ‘ Ayañhi , deva, kumāro samavaṭṭakkhandho…
content: 陛下！這位王子有完全圓滿肩膀的……。

original: ‘ Ayañhi, deva, kumāro rasaggasaggī…
content: 陛下！這位王子有最好味覺的……。

original: ‘ Ayañhi, deva, kumāro sīhahanu…
content: 陛下！這位王子有獅子下巴的……。

original: ‘ Ayañhi, deva, kumāro cattālīsadanto…
content: 陛下！這位王子有四十顆牙齒……。

original: ‘ Ayañhi, deva, kumāro samadanto…
content: 陛下！這位王子有平整牙齒的……。

original: ‘ Ayañhi, deva, kumāro aviraḷadanto…
content: 陛下！這位王子有無縫隙牙齒的……。

original: ‘ Ayañhi, deva, kumāro susukkadāṭho…
content: 陛下！這位王子有雪白牙齒的……。

original: ‘ Ayañhi, deva, kumāro pahūtajivho…
content: 陛下！這位王子有廣長舌的……。

original: ‘ Ayañhi, deva, kumāro brahmassaro karavīkabhāṇī…
content: 陛下！這位王子有梵天聲[如][[karavīkabhāṇī#美聲鳥誦出者]]……。

original: ‘ Ayañhi, deva, kumāro abhinīlanetto…
content: 陛下！這位王子有紺碧色眼睛的……。

original: ‘ Ayañhi, deva, kumāro gopakhumo…
content: 陛下！這位王子有公牛睫毛的……。

original: Imassa , deva, kumārassa uṇṇā bhamukantare jātā odātā mudutūlasannibhā.
content: 陛下！這位王子在眉毛中間有已生白色如柔軟棉花的白毫。

original: Yampi imassa deva kumārassa uṇṇā bhamukantare jātā odātā mudutūlasannibhā, idampimassa mahāpurisassa mahāpurisalakkhaṇaṃ bhavati.
content: 陛下！又，凡這位王子在眉毛中間有已生白色如柔軟棉花的白毫，陛下！這也是大丈夫的大丈夫相。

original: ‘ Ayañhi , deva, kumāro uṇhīsasīso.
content: 陛下！這位王子有肉髻頭的。

original: Yaṃ pāyaṃ, deva, kumāro uṇhīsasīso, idampissa mahāpurisassa mahāpurisalakkhaṇaṃ bhavati.
content: 陛下！又，凡這位王子有肉髻頭的，陛下！這也是大丈夫的大丈夫相。(35)

original: 36.‘ Imehi kho ayaṃ, deva, kumāro dvattiṃsamahāpurisalakkhaṇehi samannāgato, yehi samannāgatassa mahāpurisassa dveva gatiyo bhavanti anaññā.
content: 陛下！這位王子具備這三十二大丈夫相，凡具備大丈夫相者，只有二個趣處，無其它的：

original: Sace agāraṃ ajjhāvasati, rājā hoti cakkavattī dhammiko dhammarājā cāturanto vijitāvī janapadatthāvariyappatto sattaratanasamannāgato.
content: 如果居住俗家，是轉輪王、如法法王、征服四邊者、達到國土安定者、具備七寶者。

original: Tassimāni sattaratanāni bhavanti.
content: 他有這七寶，

original: Seyyathidaṃ– cakkaratanaṃ hatthiratanaṃ assaratanaṃ maṇiratanaṃ itthiratanaṃ gahapatiratanaṃ pariṇāyakaratanameva sattamaṃ.
content: 即：輪寶、象寶、馬寶、珠寶、女寶、屋主寶，主兵臣寶正是第七的。

original: Parosahassaṃ kho panassa puttā bhavanti sūrā vīraṅgarūpā parasenappamaddanā.
content: 又他有超過千位勇敢的、英雄樣子的、碎破敵對者的兒子，

original: So imaṃ pathaviṃ sāgarapariyantaṃ adaṇḍena asatthena dhammena[ dhammena samena( syā.)] abhivijiya ajjhāvasati.
content: 他以非棍棒，以非刀劍，以法征服海洋為邊界的這個土地後居住；

original: Sace kho pana agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajati, arahaṃ hoti sammāsambuddho loke vivaṭacchado’ ti.
content: 但，如果從在家出家成為無家者，是阿羅漢、遍正覺者、掀開世間中面紗者。(36)

original: Vipassīsamaññā
content: 毘婆尸的稱呼

original: 37.‘‘ Atha kho, bhikkhave, bandhumā rājā nemitte brāhmaṇe ahatehi vatthehi acchādāpetvā[ acchādetvā( syā.)] sabbakāmehi santappesi.
content: 比丘們！那時，邦都馬國王以新衣服使人使占相婆羅門們裹上後，以一切諸欲使滿足。

original: Atha kho, bhikkhave, bandhumā rājā vipassissa kumārassa dhātiyo upaṭṭhāpesi.
content: 比丘們！那時，邦都馬國王任命毘婆尸王子的乳母們，

original: Aññā khīraṃ pāyenti, aññā nhāpenti, aññā dhārenti, aññā aṅkena pariharanti.
content: 一些使吸吮乳，另一些使沐浴，另一些使生活，另一些以腰揹行。

original: Jātassa kho pana, bhikkhave, vipassissa kumārassa setacchattaṃ dhārayittha divā ceva rattiñca–
content: 比丘們！又，為已出生的毘婆尸王子日連同夜撐白傘：

original: ‘ mā naṃ sītaṃ vā uṇhaṃ vā tiṇaṃ vā rajo vā ussāvo vā bādhayitthā’ ti.
content: 『不要寒、熱、草、塵、露使他傷害。』

original: Jāto kho pana, bhikkhave, vipassī kumāro bahuno janassa piyo ahosi manāpo.
content: 比丘們！又，已出生的毘婆尸王子對眾人是可愛的、合意的，

original: Seyyathāpi, bhikkhave, uppalaṃ vā padumaṃ vā puṇḍarīkaṃ vā bahuno janassa piyaṃ manāpaṃ;
content: 比丘們，猶如青蓮，或紅蓮，或白蓮對眾人是可愛的、合意的。

original: evameva kho, bhikkhave, vipassī kumāro bahuno janassa piyo ahosi manāpo.
content: 同樣的，比丘們！毘婆尸王子對眾人是可愛的、合意的，

original: Svāssudaṃ aṅkeneva aṅkaṃ parihariyati.
content: 這位他確實就以腰到腰被揹行。(37)

original: 38.‘‘ Jāto kho pana, bhikkhave, vipassī kumāro mañjussaro ca[ kumāro brahmassaro mañjussaro ca( sī. ka.)] ahosi vaggussaro ca madhurassaro ca pemaniyassaro ca.
content: 比丘們！又，已出生的毘婆尸王子是美妙聲音者、悅耳聲音者、如蜜聲音者、深情聲音者，

original: Seyyathāpi, bhikkhave, himavante pabbate karavīkā nāma sakuṇajāti mañjussarā ca vaggussarā ca madhurassarā ca pemaniyassarā ca;
content: 比丘們！猶如在喜馬拉雅山中名為美聲鳥品種是美妙聲音者、悅耳聲音者、如蜜聲音者、深情聲音者。

original: evameva kho, bhikkhave, vipassī kumāro mañjussaro ca ahosi vaggussaro ca madhurassaro ca pemaniyassaro ca.
content: 同樣的，比丘們！毘婆尸王子是美妙聲音者、悅耳聲音者、如蜜聲音者、深情聲音者。(38)

original: 39.‘‘ Jātassa kho pana, bhikkhave, vipassissa kumārassa kammavipākajaṃ dibbacakkhu pāturahosi yena sudaṃ[ yena dūraṃ( syā.)] samantā yojanaṃ passati divā ceva rattiñca.
content: 比丘們！又，已出生的毘婆尸王子的業報生的天眼出現，以那個，日連同夜完全地看見一[[yojana#由旬]]。(39)

original: 40.‘‘ Jāto kho pana, bhikkhave, vipassī kumāro animisanto pekkhati seyyathāpi devā tāvatiṃsā.
content: 比丘們！又，已出生的毘婆尸王子不眨眼地觀看，猶如三十三天天神們。

original: ‘ Animisanto kumāro pekkhatī’ ti kho, bhikkhave[ animisanto pekkhati, jātassa kho pana bhikkhave( ka.)], vipassissa kumārassa‘ vipassī vipassī’ tveva samaññā udapādi.
content: 『王子不眨眼地觀看。』比丘們！毘婆尸王子的『毘婆尸(觀慧者)、毘婆尸』稱呼就出現。(40)

original: 41.‘‘ Atha kho, bhikkhave, bandhumā rājā atthakaraṇe[ aṭṭa karaṇe( syā.)] nisinno vipassiṃ kumāraṃ aṅke nisīdāpetvā atthe anusāsati .
content: 比丘們！那時，坐著的邦都馬國王在裁判案件中使毘婆尸王子坐在膝上後在裁判上教誡，

original: Tatra sudaṃ, bhikkhave, vipassī kumāro pituaṅke nisinno viceyya viceyya atthe panāyati ñāyena[ aṭṭe panāyati ñāṇena( syā.)].
content: 比丘們！在那裡，在父親膝上坐著的毘婆尸王子考察再考察後，以正理{{note|trigger=在裁判上評斷|text=「決斷眾事務(DA.1)」，南傳作「在裁判上評斷」(atthe panāyati, aṭṭe panāyati)，Maurice Walshe先生英譯沒譯。按：《吉祥悅意》以「在裁判上知道、看見，引導或使之轉起」解說，菩提比丘長老回函解說，此字必然是「判斷(法律案件)；對(法律案件)做出決定」：當大臣們審判案件時，王子就坐在父親的腿上，只要審判有不公正的決定，王子就發出不悅的聲音，他的父親(邦都馬國王)就會要求該案重新審理。}}，

original: Viceyya viceyya kumāro atthe panāyati ñāyenāti kho, bhikkhave, vipassissa kumārassa bhiyyosomattāya‘ vipassī vipassī’ tveva samaññā udapādi.
content: 『毘婆尸王子考察再考察後，以正理在裁判上評斷。』比丘們！毘婆尸王子的『毘婆尸、毘婆尸』稱呼就更出現。(41)

original: 42.‘‘ Atha kho, bhikkhave, bandhumā rājā vipassissa kumārassa tayo pāsāde kārāpesi, ekaṃ vassikaṃ ekaṃ hemantikaṃ ekaṃ gimhikaṃ;
content: 比丘們！那時，邦都馬國王為毘婆尸王子建造三棟高樓：一棟是雨季的、一棟是夏季的、一棟是冬季的，

original: pañca kāmaguṇāni upaṭṭhāpesi.
content: 使[[pañca kāmaguṇā#五種欲]]服侍，

original: Tatra sudaṃ, bhikkhave, vipassī kumāro vassike pāsāde cattāro māse[ vassike pāsāde vassike] nippurisehi tūriyehi paricārayamāno na heṭṭhāpāsādaṃ orohatī’’ ti.
content: 比丘們！在那裡，毘婆尸王子在雨季的高樓中，在[雨季-MN.75, AN.3.39]四個月裡被無男性的樂器[團]服侍著，不下到高樓下方。(42)

original: Paṭhamabhāṇavāro .
content: 初誦品[終了]。
